C0628.title: Criminal Gang Sentenced for Cashing Out Over 200,000 Yuan via Digital RMB Accounts in Four Days
C0628.summary: In mid-September 2023, Yuan, Zhang, Kou, and others approached merchants in Shaoxing that supported digital RMB, offering to pay handling fees in exchange for cashing out digital RMB funds through fake transactions. They cashed out over 200,000 yuan in just four days. The gang was sentenced for concealing and disguising criminal proceeds.

references.title: Using Digital RMB Accounts to Cash Out Over 200,000 Yuan in Four Days, Criminal Gang Sentenced
